description: Research profile for the proteomics process pack. Selects an ingest mode (dia | panel | dda), optional Prosit rescoring, QC thresholds, and differential-abundance / classification knobs. dda uses Sage (Apache-2.0, CPU); Sage knobs live under proteomics_quant (enzyme/cleave_at, missed_cleavages, precursor_tol_ppm, fragment_tol_ppm, variable_mods for phospho S/T/Y, lfq). Does not use methylation centroid/DMP/deconvolution config.
